title: BB-9E
description: Assigned to Supreme Leader Snoke's ship, the Supremacy, BB-9E, was a dark and gleaming state-of-the-art BB unit who rolled around on the ship keeping it in tip-top shape. He kept out a sharp photoreceptor to ensure that all things were in order and when he saw an overturned wastebasket traveling aboard the ship, he knew something was amiss and reported it to his superiors.
